title: stare.pub index build report, format 1
description: What one citation index build found: who built it from what, the totals, per-reporter counts, the volumes that failed or were allow-listed, and what changed since the previous build. Written by `stare-admin build-report` as builds/<version>/report.json and published at idx.stare.pub/v/<version>/report.json. A change that breaks a reader bumps `format` and this file's name.

stare_tag.description: The ref stare-admin was built from: a stare release tag for builds before stare-admin moved to codexpublicus/stare-builder (#163), a stare-builder ref (commit, branch or tag) after.

citare.description: The citare-core version stare-admin was built with (its git tag when it has one), from Cargo.lock.

cap_release.description: What identifies the CAP data the build read. CAP publishes no release numbers; index-build gives the SHA-256 of the mirror's VolumesMetadata.json.

reporters.description: Per reporter slug: the volumes indexed and their counts.

allowed.description: Every volume in the --allow file, with its reason and the problems the index check found (empty when the volume passed).

failed.description: Every volume that failed: `error` when it couldn't be indexed, `check` when its index failed the check and it isn't allow-listed.

volumes.description: Per reporter, per volume folder: the counts and a digest of the index files. Volumes that couldn't be indexed aren't here. The next build's diff reads this.

diff.description: What changed since the report given as --previous; null when there was none.

idx.description: What the build's unified per-volume index files (`<reporter>/<volume>.idx.gz`) hold. Absent from builds without them.

volumes.description: Volumes with an index file, as cited (a volume CAP split over several folders is one).

files.description: Index files: one per volume, more for a volume split past 1,000 lines.

split_volumes.description: Volumes in more than one file.

cl_only_volumes.description: Volumes with no CAP line: only CourtListener has them.

malformed.description: Lines a reader would skip as malformed; 0 in a sound build.

gz_bytes.description: The files' total size as stored (gzip).

max_gz_bytes.description: The largest file's size as stored.

cl_input.description: What the CourtListener export manifest given to batch-index held; null without one.

alias_lines.description: `cap` lines that are aliases into another volume (stare#151); counted in `lines.cap` too.

alias_only_volumes.description: Volumes whose file has only aliases: the manifest's `aliases`.

cl_aliases.description: What making aliases from the CourtListener crosswalk found; null or absent without one.

Parallel-citation aliases from a CourtListener crosswalk (`crosswalk.ndjson.gz`, its clusters' own citations from CourtListener's citations table): each other citation of a cluster matched to a CAP case becomes a `cap,<slug>/<folder>/<file>,via=cl:<cluster>` line in that citation's volume.

export.description: The export date, from the crosswalk's directory.

clusters.description: Crosswalk lines read: clusters CAP holds.

clusters_with_case.description: Clusters whose CAP case the index named: the only case at a matched page, or the crosswalk's `case_file` among several.

clusters_deferred.description: Clusters on a CAP page with several cases where the crosswalk names none; their aliases wait for it.

clusters_no_case.description: Clusters none of whose matched pages has a CAP case in the index.

deferred_keys.description: Keys with no line in the build that the deferred clusters' citations would add once the crosswalk names their case.

no_case_keys.description: Keys with no line in the build among the citations of clusters with no CAP case.

citations.description: Citations of the clusters with a case.

skipped_vendor.description: Westlaw and LEXIS citations, never a key.

redundant.description: Keys that already hold the cluster's own CAP case.

new_keys_held_volumes.description: Lines on a key with no other line, in a volume with cases of its own.

new_keys_new_volumes.description: Lines on a key with no other line, in a volume of aliases only.

cross_links.description: Lines on a key that holds a different CAP case (a second CAP printing); CAP's own case still comes first.

duplicates.description: Aliases another cluster already gave the same key and case; written once.

conflicts.description: Keys that clusters alias to different cases: a page several cases share, or a wrong citation on one side. All are written, and listed for review.

collisions.description: Keys that hold only other clusters' CourtListener lines: a duplicate cluster or a wrong citation. Not written; listed for review.

export.description: The export date, from the manifest's directory.

lines.description: Index lines made; a citation indexed under two slugs makes two.

skipped_vendor.description: Westlaw and LEXIS citations, never a reporter volume.

skipped_volume.description: Citations whose volume can't be a path.

skipped_page.description: Citations whose page can't be a line's page.

skipped_slug.description: Citations of a reporter citare has no edition for.

derived_slug.description: Builds before citare v0.6.0: citations of a reporter CAP doesn't have, slugged from its name.

slug_by_name.description: Citations citare didn't find in their citation string, slugged by their reporter's edition name.

several_slugs.description: Citations indexed under several slugs: an edition name citare splits between reporters (`Hill`, `Ct. Cl.`).

slugs_differ.description: Citations whose manifest `slugs` aren't citare's; the index uses citare's.

split_volumes.description: Volume numbers CAP split over several folders, from the build's manifest.json; null without one.

split_parts.description: The folders those volumes are split over.

cases.description: Case files in the indexed volumes' zips.

shortfall.description: Cases without an entry, summed per volume (a volume with extra entries counts 0).

long_names.description: Pages whose first case's name is too long for the .bin.

allowed.description: Allow-listed volumes that failed the check.

digest.description: The first 16 hex digits of the SHA-256 of the .bin, then the .multi when there is one; null when the .bin is missing.

volumes_changed.description: Volumes in both builds whose counts or index files differ.

counts_changed.description: The changed volumes whose case or entry counts differ.

reporters.description: Reporters whose entry count changed (0 for a reporter that wasn't there).
